cases.refreshed: Adults and teens, join us the first Friday every month for an English-style tea service. In the event the first Friday is a holiday, the program will run on the first Friday of the month the branch is open. Tea and a biscuit will be served. All are welcome to Byoc (Bring Your Own Cup). We'll have paper cups available also. Refreshments are subject to limitation.
